name: squad
description: A maintenance squad for the Theo ecosystem: 8 domain specialists plus a measurement-first pipeline (BACKLOG → DISCOVER → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → CODE-QUALITY → REVIEW → RELEASE) where every item is a hypothesis, evidence comes from our own code and runtime, and killing an item is a successful outcome.
author: usetheo
_comment_: Derived from the Cycle plugin (MIT). Cycle is greenfield and stack-agnostic: its DISCOVER studies how OTHER projects solved a problem, and it forbids looking at your own code. Squad inverts that — it maintains a running ecosystem, so DISCOVER measures OUR code and runtime, and prior art can never be evidence. This repository is dual-mode: (1) standalone — open the directory directly in Claude Code; settings.json + hooks/* + skills/* + rules/* + agents/* work as-is; (2) plugin — install via marketplace. Both modes share the same source.
